title: fix: prefer Anthropic with AWS fallback for Claude
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.1 now route to Anthropic first, with AWS Bedrock as the sole fallback for each model. This adds a fallback for Sonnet and Fable and replaces the Vercel fallback for Haiku and OpenRouter fallback for Opus. Public model IDs, capabilities, and user prices are preserved. Gen adds encrypted Anthropic credentials for development, staging, and production; PDF handling now supports Anthropic's document format, and Bedrock fallback credentials are read from Worker bindings. The Privacy Policy describes how Claude routing determines who receives request content, and the Service Providers list adds Anthropic.
